title: Why utility bikes ride upright
summary: See how step-through access, swept bars, cockpit height and wheelbase shape everyday comfort, visibility and low-speed control.

steps.title: The frame is built around easy access.
steps.body: A step-through frame lowers the structure the rider must pass over when mounting or dismounting. That can make frequent stops, ordinary clothing and loaded everyday riding more convenient.
steps.keyFact: Step-through describes frame architecture, not rider gender or ability.

steps.title: The hands come back toward the rider.
steps.body: The raised stem and swept handlebar position the hands closer to the rider than a performance road cockpit. The result is a more upright torso and strong low-speed steering leverage.
steps.keyFact: An upright position trades some aerodynamic efficiency for comfort, visibility and easy control.

steps.title: Utility geometry favors predictable everyday handling.
steps.body: Urban U1 combines an upright rider position with a relatively long, stable chassis. This is useful when stopping often, carrying ordinary luggage and riding through city traffic at moderate speeds.
steps.keyFact: Stable does not mean slow to steer; it means the geometry is not optimized around aggressive racing or technical-trail handling.

steps.title: Comfort is a system, not a saddle alone.
steps.body: The saddle, swept bar, grips, pedals and tire volume all influence how the rider experiences the bicycle. Changing only one contact point cannot fully define comfort.
steps.keyFact: Comfort depends on fit, posture, contact points, tires, rider and ride duration.

steps.title: Find the component that most directly shapes hand position.
steps.body: Identify the part whose rearward sweep is a defining feature of this upright cockpit.
steps.keyFact: The handlebar shape strongly influences hand position and steering leverage.

challenge.prompt: Which component gives Urban U1 its swept-back hand position?
challenge.successText: Correct. The swept handlebar moves the grips rearward and supports the upright cockpit.
challenge.retryText: That component affects rider position, but it is not the swept steering bar.
